title: Third Shift Emergency Services Clinician
description:
Full-Time | Nashua, NH


Greater Nashua Mental Health is looking for a third shift (8PM - 8AM) Emergency Services Clinician to join our Emergency Services team! This role provides crisis intervention, assessment, stabilization, and short-term treatment services to individuals and families experiencing behavioral health emergencies. Working alongside first responders, hospitals, healthcare providers, and community partners, the ES Clinician helps stabilize psychiatric crises, reduce the need for hospitalization or incarceration, and connect individuals with appropriate ongoing care.

Want to learn more about who we are and the work we do?

Website: Greater Nashua Mental Health Center | Non-Profit Mental Healthcare Center | GNMH
YouTube Channel: Greater Nashua Mental Health (GNMH) - YouTube

Explore our YouTube channel to hear from our team, learn about our programs, and gain deeper insight into our mission, culture, and community impact.


Questions about this opportunity?
Contact our Recruitment team:

Anthony Legere

recruitment@gnmhc.org

603-402-1594

603-889-6147 ext 1594


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide emergency crisis evaluations for youth, adults, and older adults in hospitals, community settings, and GNMH locations.
  • Conduct comprehensive crisis assessments, risk evaluations, and mental status examinations.
  • Deliver crisis intervention, short-term counseling, stabilization services, and case management.
  • Assess suicide risk, violence potential, mental health needs, and appropriate levels of care.
  • Utilize evidence-based practices and screening tools to support crisis stabilization and treatment planning.
  • Triage individuals in behavioral health crisis and coordinate referrals to appropriate services and resources.
  • Collaborate with psychiatrists, case managers, hospitals, law enforcement, first responders, and community agencies.
  • Conduct emergency room consultations and evaluations in partnership with medical staff.
  • Participate in IEA and Conditional Discharge processes in accordance with NH regulations.
  • Maintain timely, accurate, and compliant clinical documentation.
  • Participate in team meetings, supervision, training, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Support a 24/7 crisis response system, including non-traditional shifts and weekends as needed.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Counseling, Social Work, or related mental health discipline required.
  • 1–2 years of behavioral health, crisis services, or related clinical experience preferred.
  • Strong assessment, diagnostic, crisis intervention, and de-escalation skills.
  • Knowledge of evidence-based treatment approaches and recovery-oriented care.
  • Valid driver license, reliable transportation, and insurance required.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records and Microsoft Office applications.

Why Work for Us

We are looking for collaborative, curious for knowledge people with a “can do” mentality to join our team of compassionate employees! We provide a stimulating work environment and offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits including:

  • Choice of 2 health insurance plans
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangement
  • Health Plan Opt Out Benefit
  • Health Savings Account
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • Accident & Critical Illness Insurances
  • 403b Retirement Plan with Agency Match
  • Employee Assistance Plan
  • Generous Earned Time Off
  • Paid Extended Sick Time
  • 10 Paid Holidays + your birthday!
  • Bereavement Leave
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Qualifying Employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program and NH State Loan Repayment Program

Salary Range: $54,438 - $84,584


Greater Nashua Mental Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Fine Cheese / Beer & Wine Associate
description:
Fine Cheese, Beer & Wine Associate

Position Overview

McKinnon's Market & Super Butcher Shop is seeking a friendly, dependable Fine Cheese, Beer & Wine Associate to help maintain our specialty cheese and beer and wine departments.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with food, assisting customers, and keeping displays attractive and well stocked. The associate will prepare and package specialty cheeses, maintain the cheese case, stock beer and wine products, and help customers find the right selections.

Previous specialty cheese, beer and wine, grocery, or retail experience is helpful, but we are willing to train the right candidate.

Responsibilities

  • Cut, weigh, wrap, price, and label specialty cheeses.
  • Keep the fine cheese case fully stocked, organized, clean, and attractively displayed.
  • Monitor product quality, freshness, dates, and proper rotation.
  • Help customers select cheeses based on their tastes, needs, or occasion.
  • Answer customer questions and provide friendly, knowledgeable service.
  • Help customers locate beer and wine products.
  • Stock and organize beer and wine deliveries.
  • Build and maintain attractive product displays.
  • Ensure products are properly priced and signed.
  • Maintain clean and sanitary work areas, equipment, and displays.
  • Follow all food-safety procedures and company policies.
  • Assist with inventory and other department duties as needed.

Qualifications

  • Friendly, dependable, and customer focused.
  • Interest in learning about specialty cheeses, beer, and wine.
  • Strong attention to detail when weighing, pricing, and labeling products.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good communication and organizational skills.
  • Previous grocery, specialty food, cheese, beer and wine, or retail experience is preferred but not required.
  • Must meet all applicable age requirements for handling beer and wine products.
  • Availability to work a flexible schedule, including some evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, reach, twist, and perform repetitive tasks.
  • Ability to safely use cheese-cutting, wrapping, weighing, and labeling equipment.
  • Ability to lift and carry cases of product weighing up to approximately 40–50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in refrigerated areas as needed.

description:

  • Translate business requirements and technology trends into scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure solutions.
  • Define standards, lead design decisions, govern technical quality, and guide the team through complex infrastructure programmes.
  • Ensure operational platforms remain current, performant, and aligned to the strategic roadmap.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures and target-state designs for VMware VCF 9.0 platform architecture and lifecycle patterns.
  • Define our Aria Operations observability strategy, including telemetry standards, alert philosophy, capacity/performance governance, and service reporting, and ensure operational adoption.

  • Define backup and recovery architecture using Veeam and Data Domain, including recoverability assurance and DR readiness patterns.

  • Define VDI/RDS architecture and standards for Omnissa Horizon, Workspace ONE, and Microsoft RDS, including availability, scalability, security controls, patch and lifecycle strategy, monitoring, and DR considerations.
  • Define enterprise image/template strategy, including repeatable build pipelines with Packer, template/content distribution using VMware Content Library, validation gates, versioning, rollback, and security hardening baselines.
  • Lead solution design and implementation for major infrastructure programmes, migrations, and technology refresh initiatives.
  • Serve as escalation point for the most complex cross-domain incidents and systemic problem elimination, ensuring strong problem records and post-incident outputs in ServiceNow.
  • Establish engineering standards for automation and configuration management.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor solutions, produce technology assessments, proof-of-concept outcomes, and formal recommendations to IT leadership.

title: Scientist II, Pharmaceutical Development
description:
Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)



About the Role:

Represent Preformulation and Pharmaceutical Development within Technical Operations by collaborating on project teams from early discovery through development, predominately focusing on pre-FIH molecules in a fast-paced non-GMP environment. The candidate will develop phase appropriate fit-for-purpose analytical methods, design and execute preformulation studies for multiple preclinical/clinical programs, identify developability risks for potential development candidates. Additionally, this role is responsible for authoring and reviewing technical documentation including regulatory submissions and scientific reports. Success in this role will require sound technical judgment, the ability to identify development risks, implementation of innovative analytical technologies, and effectively communicate complex scientific findings to multidisciplinary teams to support R&D decision-making.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Collaborate with Research/Discovery, Preclinical & Clinical Pharmacology, and Technical Operations to facilitate communication, ensuring emerging and updated pharmaceutical development data is shared widely and used effectively by the broader R&D Team

  • Design and develop phase appropriate analytical methods (HPLC-UV, LC-MS, MS-MS, SEC-HPLC, etc.) studies in support of early pharmaceutical development activities

  • Design and execute studies in support of developability assessments (i.e. thermodynamic & kinetic solubility, chemical & physical stability, excipient compatibility, etc.), preclinical formulation development, and support molecule/form selection

  • Research new instrumentation and analytical technologies to be implemented when needed for development support

  • Scientific review of electronic lab notebooks, technical development reports, stability summaries, DFA memos, regulatory submissions, and other relevant documentation

  • Assemble and/or maintain information repository to allow efficient retrieval of early pharmaceutical development data, physiochemical properties, and scientific knowledge regarding molecules in the R&D pipeline

  • Present updates at department meetings and deliver scientific talks on current and new techniques/technology in support of early pharmaceutical development

  • Lead or participate in weekly or bi-weekly project team meetings and inform both up and down the chain of command as to progress, resource gaps, and timelines

  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BS/BA degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including experience in a chemistry, analytical, or characterization laboratory setting OR
  • MS/MA degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years of similar experience noted above OR
  • PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or related field AND some relevant experience; may include postdoc experience
  • Demonstration of cross-functional understanding related to molecule selection and drug development is strongly preferred
  • Must have technical expertise in analytical method development and preformulation sciences
  • Technical expertise in LC-MS is strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Agilent OpenLab software is a plus
  • Expertise with fit-for-purpose method development and phase appropriate method qualification/ validation to determine solubility, stability, and other pharmaceutically relevant properties of novel therapeutics (including small molecules, peptides, and other biologic modalities)
  • Familiarity with a variety of pharmaceutical dosage forms (parenteral, oral solutions/suspensions, SDD, HME, SEDDS, etc.) to design appropriate developability studies and identify potential development risks
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory guidelines in preparing and authoring the drug product sections of INDs/CTAs and NDAs/BLAs
  • Strong knowledge and expertise of the following instrumentation and techniques is required; HPLC (SEC, UV, MS, IEX, etc), Open Lab software, solubility analysis, pKa determination, Log P/D, and other preformulation studies
  • A working knowledge of the following is required; DSC, TGA, PXRD, NMR, Particle-Size Analysis, GVS, PLM, and SEM
  • Consistently recognizes anomalous and inconsistent results and interprets experimental outcomes
  • Strong knowledge of one or more scientific disciplines, becoming expert in one discipline
  • Strong knowledge of scientific principles, methods and techniques
  • Strong knowledge and demonstrated ability working with a variety of laboratory equipment/tools
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members
  • Analytical thinker with problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to complete technical assignments by supporting the design, execution and interpretation of complex experiments
  • Ability to deliver results within defined budget, timing, and resources constraints. Awareness of impact(s) on other functional areas
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working as part of a cross-functional teams, and an ability to meet timelines efficiently and productively
  • Ability to monitor on-going experiments and suggest alternatives or solutions
  • Advanced knowledge with Excel, Word, PowerPoint and other associated software used in the scientific field
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced planning, organization and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects

description:

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

  • Excellent written communication and ability to turn complex business topics into clear narratives.

  • Experience with corporate development, investments, M&A or corporate communications is useful.

  • Hands-on operating style - able to research, analyse, write and drive strategic work personally.

Our service center teams keep people safely on the road — and we’re hiring people who want to build a career doing it. Transitioning into her own home gives her the opportunity to build self-reliance, establish her own routines, and set her own rules free from past conflict.

This young woman is empathetic and caring, goal-oriented and determined, culturally proud, expressive and stylish. She wants to be treated fairly, respected, and seen as capable, independent, and strong. It’s important that she is able to do things for herself around her new home, including: laundry, cooking and baking, and cleaning. She enjoys listening to music, dressing up and looking her best, and staying active and healthy.

How best to support her:

  • Stay calm and respectful
  • Listen first
  • Ask permission
  • Set clear expectations
  • Offer breaks
  • Recognize effort
  • Validate feelings

A successful lead staff will have strong boundaries, experience with mental health and conflict resolution, the ability to not take things personally, and can make her feel like you are not above her but side-by-side. She is looking for someone who is willing to get to know her before instructing her.


Responsibilities:

The Housemate/Live-in Staff provide training and habilitation services and instruction, as well as personal assistance to the individual they live with in their home, neighborhoods, school, and/or job sites. Under supervision of Lead Staff and Facilitators, Housemate/Live-In Staff will provide support to individuals who have one or more of the following challenges or needs: developmental disabilities, physical challenges, and/or need for psychological support.


Duties:

  1. Implement training and support services to individuals as specified in Individual Support Plan (ISP). The areas of training and monitoring include, but are not limited to: housing, personal finance, mobility and accessibility, health and safety, relationships, recreation, self advocacy, job training, decision making and problem solving.
  2. Participate in the development and implementation of support plans.
  3. Assist with household duties such as cleaning, laundry, cooking, and household management to maintain the household in accordance with the guidelines determined by the person receiving support.
  4. Maintain all necessary individual records and evaluations.
  5. Medication administration during prescribed times, complete and maintain shift notes and medication documentation.
  6. Assist with personal care routines such as bathing, dressing, and all personal care needed/necessary for the person(s) receiving services. This may include any lifting or moving required to complete the above tasks.
  7. Participate in team meetings to discuss services.
  8. Provide input for program planning.
  9. Communicate as required/requested with team lead and facilitator concerning services, training, etc. with each individual you support.
  10. Ensure shift coverage for the person receiving services when emergency coverage needs arise.
  11. Participate in house/yard upkeep tasks to maintain the cleanliness of areas such as common areas, kitchen, front yard, backyard, and bathrooms.
  12. Assist with moving possessions in the event of a change in residence.
  13. Ensure cleanliness and care of the rental property in relation to the health and safety of the individual we support.
  14. Provide support to individuals during hospitalizations or medical stays, including those that may occur outside of Santa Cruz County. This includes remaining with the individual as assigned to ensure continuity of care, safety, communication with medical providers, and advocacy. Assignments may include extended or overnight shifts based on individual needs and program requirements.

Job Duty Allocation:

  1. No time in excess of 20% of any given shift shall be allocated towards completing housekeeping tasks and duties alone.
  2. Activities that pertain to training new staff on housekeeping duties or supporting persons we support to complete housekeeping duties should not be factored into the 20% of time allocated towards housekeeping tasks.
  3. If you feel that you are spending more than 20% of your shifts completing housekeeping tasks, please contact your direct supervisor to resolve this matter.
  4. Examples of housekeeping tasks may include: washing dishes, laundry, scrubbing or sweeping floors.

Qualifications:

Knowledge of the needs of persons with developmental disabilities. Possess the skills to effectively teach persons with disabilities, demonstrate the ability to encourage persons supported to make informed choices, and facilitate opportunities for growth in the individuals supported. Must be able to work with minimal supervision.


Training and Requirements:

  1. High school diploma or equivalent
  2. Two years experience and/or training in the fields of developmental disabilities, psychology, etc. are beneficial but not required
  3. The ability to maintain CPR/First Aid Certification
  4. Must maintain valid California driver's license and proper insurance, if driving with the person supported
  5. Department of Justice level criminal background check

Status:

Non-exempt, hourly position. If regularly scheduled for 30 or more hours each week, the employee is full time and eligible for all applicable benefits.


Work Schedule:

This is a full-time position. We offer flexibility with days and hours and will work collaboratively with the right candidate to create a schedule that works well for both the employee and the individual they are supporting.


Sample preferred schedule:

Monday-Friday 4pm-overnight-8am


Benefits:

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Referral program
  • Retirement plan

Housemate Specific Benefits:

  • Free rent
  • Portion of utilities paid for each month

We have additional opportunities available for strong candidates who may not be the right fit for the Housemate or Lead Staff role, including a Support Staff position with weekend hours. If you’re interested in being considered for the Support Staff position, you can apply here: https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/3680884

JOB OBJECTIVE:
The middle market underwriter reviews risks, determines acceptability, and successfully writes profitable business accounts. Within designated authority, reviews insurance applications to evaluate, classify and rate each risk to determine acceptability, coverage and pricing. Responsible for the financial performance of the assigned book of business and is expected to achieve profitable retention and new business growth. Focused on taking action to achieve results that positively impact sales and profitability while ensuring excellent customer service and timely responsiveness to independent agents for their commercial lines accounts.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Determine the acceptability, quality, pricing, profitability and opportunity for new and existing business.
2. Complete thorough risk analysis on designated accounts using appropriate Encova, NCCI, ISO and industry rules, policies, procedures, and guidelines, etc.
3. Identify, create and initiate new business opportunities within current book of business and assigned agencies.
4. Gather and analyze information necessary to make an accurate evaluation of risk.
5. Accept or reject commercial lines accounts that fall outside of straight through processing rules through exposure identification and risk analysis, including:
• understanding all exposures that might cause a policy to incur losses;
• conservatively assessing the likelihood of any exposure actually causing a loss and the probable cost if it does;
• setting a premium that, on average, would deliver a profit after both prospective loss costs and operating expenses are covered;
• be willing to walk away if the appropriate premium cannot be obtained.
6. Apply discretionary pricing appropriately based on risk exposures, risk quality, loss potential, pricing model indications and your letter of authority.
7. Determine acceptability of revision requests that fall outside straight through processing rules and communicate how the revision will be handled to the Associate Underwriter.
8. Communicate all underwriting decisions or changes on coverage, limits, exposures and/or pricing, discussing alternatives with assigned agents as needed.
9. Promote effective agency relationships and encourage continued use of our company products and technology.
10. Provide support to appointed agents by serving as a resource for underwriting questions.
11. Utilizes Encova systems to transact requests and endorsements.
12. Utilize available resources including company underwriting guidelines, business unit strategies, and consultations with others to ensure adequate understanding of risk exposures.
13. Prepare proposals to producers, including negotiation of terms and conditions.
14. Ensure the proper issuance of policies, certificates, filings and notifications.
15. Seek the guidance of management on risks exceeding assigned authority levels.
16. Effectively utilize industry rules and guidance to ensure proper policy construction.
17. Identify underwriting issues; recommend and develop plans for problem resolution and implement them where appropriate.
18. Manage existing and prospective accounts by actively participating in account renewals, new business presentations as needed and discussion with agents.
19. Participate in monitoring and analyzing growth and profitability of assigned agents; initiate actions and understand downstream impact of alternatives.
20. Mentor entry-level underwriters and trainees to achieve profitable retention, growth and customer service standards.
21. Serve as a resource for other team members and units.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Maintain an awareness of the current objectives and initiatives of Encova Insurance.
2. Maintain an understanding of all products offered by Encova Insurance and be able to guide agents to the appropriate contact for needs outside of commercial lines.
3. Travel to various locations to support business objectives when necessary.

4. Perform other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Minimum 2 years of commercial lines underwriting experience in package lines and/or worker’s compensation in the Property and Casualty insurance market strongly preferred.
• Bachelor’s degree preferred, demonstrated significant underwriting experience may substitute.
• Interpersonal skills are required including the ability to demonstrate professionalism, adaptability, accountability, collaboration and problem solving.
• Insurance designations or insurance education course work (i.e. AINS-Associate in General Insurance) strongly preferred.
• Critical thinking: Ability to assess an individual situation and select applicable rules from an array of options, resulting in the most appropriate and sustainable decision.
• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Knowledge of underwriting laws and rules and their application.
• Knowledge of policy and procedures regarding risk administration and risk management, underwriting and loss control.
• Knowledge of the insurance industry and the business environment in which it operates in order to develop an effective business strategy and remain technically current.
• Thorough understanding of business exposure calculations, classifications, experience rating or other plan modifications.
• Ability to develop and implement account, territorial, producer and book strategies to acquire and retain business.
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Ability to use logic and reasoning to identify strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
• Ability to identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
• Ability to make sound decisions after considering all facts, potential risks, customer needs and alternative solutions.
• Ability to initiate and build relationships and tailor services to meet customer needs.
• Ability to present ideas and information to individuals and groups in a clear, concise, influential, organized and diplomatic manner and address concerns or needs.
• Ability to adjust priorities based on changing situations.
• Ability to effectively manage multiple assignments while meeting established guidelines.

• Proficient in Excel.

This position has been evaluated in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Encova Insurance makes every effort to reasonably accommodate disabilities to permit performance of the essential functions and candidates who need such accommodation are encouraged to seek it. This description reflects the nature and level of work performed by associates in this position. It is not an all-inclusive inventory of duties, responsibilities and qualifications required. It provides an accurate overview of the work and skills needed to perform this position. Because job content may change from time to time, Encova Insurance reserves the right to add and/or delete functions from this job as it deems necessary for business reasons.

Join us to discover a work experience where you can learn and grow to your fullest potential.

In addition to a competitive compensation package, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our associates. Available benefits (subject to any policy or plan changes) include, but are not limited to:

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
04th September, 2026

A2B Australia is part of the ComfortDelGro Australia (CDC) Group, the country’s leading taxi network and a major provider of mobility, technology, and payment solutions.
Through our iconic brands 13cabs, Silver Service, Swan Taxis and Cabcharge we deliver end‑to‑end transport experiences, from booking and dispatch through to safe, reliable travel and seamless payment. Our services support corporate, community and disability customers nationwide.
Our network is Australia’s largest, with 7,000+ vehicles and 11,500 drivers, supported by contact centres, technology hubs and in‑field support teams. We power drivers, operators and passengers with dispatch, navigation, in‑car tech, apps and payment solutions across Australia and globally.

The A2B Way
We care about our customers, our business and each other. We work as one connected team, value accountability and collaboration, and encourage innovation to shape the future of mobility. We invest in wellbeing, safety, learning and development, recognise high performance, and celebrate diversity and inclusion.

At A2B Australia, we're transforming the way Australians move through our brands including 13cabs. As we continue to evolve our pricing capability, we're looking for a commercially minded Pricing Analyst to help shape the future of pricing across our network.
This isn't a role where you'll simply maintain existing reports or follow established frameworks.

Our pricing function is being built from the ground up, and we're looking for someone who enjoys creating structure where none exists, challenging assumptions, and using data to solve complex commercial problems. You'll work closely with Product, Technology and Commercial teams to influence pricing decisions that impact thousands of drivers, passengers and businesses across Australia.
If you're energised by analytics, experimentation, pricing strategy and commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing
As a key member of the pricing team, you'll support the development and optimisation of pricing strategies through rigorous analysis, modelling and experimentation.
Key responsibilities include:

  • Analysing fare, fee and pricing performance to identify optimisation opportunities and commercial risks.
  • Building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and pricing reporting for business stakeholders.
  • Developing pricing models and scenario analysis to assess revenue, profitability, utilisation and margin outcomes.
  • Measuring passenger and driver price elasticity to understand behavioural responses to pricing changes.
  • Supporting the development and testing of dynamic and surge pricing frameworks.
  • Designing, executing and evaluating pricing experiments and A/B testing initiatives.
  • Monitoring pricing performance and identifying anomalies, leakage and margin risks.
  • Supporting driver commission, subscription and incentive modelling.
  • Conducting competitive analysis across taxi, rideshare and mobility providers including Uber, DiDi and others.
  • Partnering with Product and Technology teams to improve pricing capability and automation.
  • Performing post-implementation reviews to validate pricing outcomes and business impact.
  • Documenting frameworks, methodologies and learnings to support an evolving pricing capability.
About You
You're naturally curious, commercially astute and passionate about using data to influence decisions.

You'll bring:
  • 3+ years' experience in Pricing, Revenue Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Data Analytics or a similar role.
  • Strong Power BI capability is essential.
  • Exposure to SQL, Python, R or similar analytical tools would be advantageous but is not required.
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets from multiple systems and data sources.
  • Advanced Excel and analytical skills.
  • Experience with statistical analysis, modelling and experimentation.
  • The ability to communicate complex findings in a simple and practical way.
  • A tertiary qualification in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Analytics or a related discipline.
We're looking for someone who:
  • Enjoys solving complex business problems through data.
  • Can challenge the status quo and think beyond existing processes.
  • Is comfortable operating in an environment where not everything is already defined.
  • Takes ownership and drives outcomes independently.
  • Balances analytical rigour with commercial pragmatism.
  • Enjoys partnering with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Gets excited by building something from the ground up.
Why Join A2B?
  • Opportunity to help build a pricing function from the ground up.
  • Influence pricing decisions that directly impact revenue, profitability and network performance.
  • Work with large-scale real-world datasets across a national business.
  • Partner with Product, Technology and Commercial leaders.
  • Solve complex pricing and commercial challenges using advanced analytics and experimentation.
  • Be part of the transformation of one of Australia's most recognised mobility brands.
Ready to make a difference? Apply today and become part of our vibrant team at our Alexandria office!

ComfortDelGro Corporation Australia (CDC) and A2B acknowledges the Traditional Custodians throughout Australia, and their continuing connection to land, waters and community. We pay our respects to all First Nations people, their culture and to Elders past and present.

title: Data Modeller
description:
Help us deliver like never before

We’re looking for a Data Modeller to join our diverse, talented and innovative team. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders across the business, partnering to solve complex data challenges, uplift our modelling capability, and enable teams to deliver consistent, trusted data outcomes for Australia Post.

We're empowered to deliver for our teams and to delight our customers. We provide an inclusive and supportive environment that nurtures talented people, trusts our teams to deliver their best, and leverages modern work practices and technologies. It's an unexpectedly dynamic and collaborative culture that feels more like a start-up than a 213-year old icon.

What you’ll deliver with us

As our Data Modeller you’ll help support in developing and maintaining Australia Post’s Enterprise Data Model. You’ll collaborate with diverse stakeholders to turn complex enterprise data into clear, standardised models, and contribute hands‑on to high‑impact data initiatives that drive real business outcomes.

This role requires to sit with business SMEs, understand the business processes, design models and help design applications and integrations rather than data warehousing.

This is a fixed term, 12-month opportunity.

You’ll also

  • Design and build the enterprise data model, encompassing conceptual, logical, and physical data models that align with business requirements and data strategies.
  • Manage stakeholders with the ability to lead data modelling discussions, drive solution design conversations, align business and technical teams, and ensure modelling decisions meet enterprise standards and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and data architects to gather, analyse, and refine data requirements, ensuring they are accurately translated into the data model.
  • Define data entities, relationships, and attributes, ensuring the model supports current and future business needs.
  • Map source data into the enterprise data model and maintain updated and organised documentation of such mapping and maintain comprehensive model documentation
  • Support the Principal Data Modeller to establish the practice, define patterns, standards and principles that will guide the activities of project data modellers and external contractors.
  • Design and optimise data models for analytical and operational systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and data quality.

About you

You bring experience with established data modelling methodologies and a strong, confident communication style. You take ownership, ask the right questions, and proactively drive meaningful data discussions. With proven stakeholder management skills, you can lead data modelling and solution design conversations, align business and technical teams, and ensure outcomes meet enterprise standards and business objectives.

You’ll also need

  • Proven experience in data modelling, data architecture, or a related role. This role is more than just pure Data Modelling, if you are a Data Architect with data modelling experience then that is an ideal background.
  • Knowledge of diverse data modelling techniques such as dimensional modelling, data vault, 3NF, etc.Proficient in using ER/Studio or Erwin for enterprise data modelling, including logical and physical model design, metadata management, lineage, and model governance.
  • Implement and optimise physical data models into cloud (we use Google BigQuery), ensuring alignment with platform capabilities and performance considerations.

How we’ll deliver for you

  • Join a supportive and collaborative team who jump in and support and share knowledge openly.
  • Be part of a culture where everybody feels they belong, are valued, and can bring their authentic self to work every day.
  • We offer a great range of benefits, including a focus on work-life balance & flexibility, career development opportunities, and exclusive discounts through our Post Perks program.

We’re delivering together

At Australia Post, we acknowledge the Traditional Custodians of the land on which we operate, live and gather as employees.

We believe our business should reflect the diverse communities we operate in and are proud to be an inclusive workplace for people from all walks of life. We encourage applications from people of all ages, genders and backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, People with Disability, LGBTQIA+ and Refugees.

We are one of the largest organisations in Australia to successfully achieve Disability Confident Recruiter status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process and workplace for those living with a disability and are committed to reviewing and removing bias in our processes to create a gender-equitable recruitment experience and workplace. If you have any questions about accessibility, please contact our Diversity & Inclusion team on inclusivecareers@auspost.com.au.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.






THE ROLE:

We are seeking a seasoned SoC Micro architect with expertise or significant interest in System Architecture.   • Comprehend the SOC as a complete system which includes HW (Silicon), FW, BIOS & SW and ensure that FW, BIOS & SW are aligned to enable all features, optimizing for performance and power

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

title: Overnight Associate Booking Producer
description:
As the Overnight Associate Booking Producer, you will work as part of NBC News’ Booking and Editorial Unit, on the News and Politics team, responsible for booking guests across all platforms of NBC News, including TODAY, Weekend TODAY, Nightly News, Weekend Nightly News, Meet the Press, Dateline, Specials, as well as our streaming network NBC News NOW and all digital platforms.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage short- and long-term bookings across multiple NBC News platforms.
  • Pitch story ideas and work on assigned bookings as they are launched by editorial teams and shows.
  • Coordinate guest travel and live shot logistics in partnership with production teams and arrange editorial guidance and pre-interviews with segment producers.
  • Support the team in on set and remote guest coordination for tape and live segments, helping to book and organize guests across various broadcast and NBC News NOW shows.
  • Work with the team to give direction to bookers in the field, as well as coordinate and schedule guests and analysts, often during breaking news.
  • Responsible for compiling and sending out our daily booking note which details all booking efforts and secured guests as well as organizing the team’s bookings into comprehensive handovers for the next day.
  • Must have at least 2 years of experience working in production or booking at the network level.
  • Must have a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • This job is a Sunday to Thursday schedule, with the shift beginning in the afternoon and ending in the mid-overnight hours (around 2-3am). Must be able to work additional hours beyond scheduled shift with little or no notice if needed.
  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, under tight deadline pressure, including breaking news.
  • Must be willing to travel with little notice, and for extended periods.
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY.
  • Must be willing to take a background investigation.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.

Desired Characteristics:

  • A genuine news junkie who gets their information from a wide range of sources be it broadcast, newsletters, podcasts, social media or anything in between.
  • Someone who starts the day by checking news alerts, morning shows, and socials to know the stories everyone will be talking about.
  • Strong journalistic writing skills, research skills, and editorial judgment.
  • Understands how to work with people in serious, sometimes sensitive and stressful situations.
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment where the day we started at 9AM may be totally different by noon.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize assignments.
  • Strong knowledge of all social media platforms.
  • Knowledge of NBC News Policies and Guidelines and Practices.
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge and interest in news and current events.

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

title: Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Manipulation
description:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.

About the Job

Field AI is building the future of autonomy—from rugged terrain to real-world deployment. We’re on a mission to develop intelligent, adaptable robotic systems that operate beyond simulation and thrive in unpredictable environments. As our Robotics Autonomy Engineer – Manipulation, you’ll lead the development and deployment of whole-body control and manipulation capabilities for humanoids and arm-equipped quadrupeds, turning real field scenarios into behaviors our robots perform reliably every day. You’ll be part of a deeply technical team advancing real-world robotic capabilities through cutting-edge research, simulation tools, and field validation. If building robots that can use their hands in the real world excites you, and you want to work where your code hits the ground (literally)—this is your role. This is Field AI.

What You’ll Get To Do

  • Develop whole-body control and manipulation capabilities for humanoids and quadrupeds with arms, coordinating base, torso, and arm motion as a single system
  • Take specific field scenarios from concept to repeatable execution on hardware, interacting with the built environment and handling objects and tools
  • Build learning based and model based manipulation policies and integrate them tightly with perception and locomotion
  • Train manipulation policies from demonstration data and adapt vision language action (VLA) foundation models to our robots and tasks, then make them work on hardware
  • Design grasp, contact, and force interaction strategies that hold up across varied objects, surfaces, and environments, with interaction forces kept safe for people and equipment nearby
  • Harden behaviors so they succeed across repeated runs, changing lighting, object variation, and real site conditions
  • Build simulation environments and evaluation pipelines for manipulation, and use field data to close the gap between simulation and the real world
  • Deploy on physical robots and iterate rapidly through lab testing and field validation
  • Work closely with locomotion, perception, and systems engineers to deliver end to end capabilities

What You Have

  • Master’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD strongly preferred)
  • Deep expertise in robot manipulation or whole-body control
  • 2+ years of experience developing and deploying manipulation behaviors on real robotic systems (preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with robot arms, hands or grippers, and humanoid or mobile manipulation platforms
  • Solid understanding of kinematics, dynamics, contact modeling, and force control
  • Experience with manipulation planning and control, such as trajectory optimization or model predictive control (MPC)
  • Experience with learning based manipulation, such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning (RL), or vision language action models
  • Proficiency with simulation tools such as Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or Drake
  • Experience integrating perception for manipulation
  • Strong Python and/or C++ development skills in Linux-based development environments
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
  • A passion for building things that move in the real world

The Extras That Set You Apart

  • 3+ years of experience in an industry or startup robotics setting
  • Experience with loco-manipulation on legged platforms or whole-body model predictive control for humanoids
  • Experience fine tuning or deploying vision language action models on real robots
  • Experience building teleoperation and demonstration data collection pipelines at scale
  • Experience with cross embodiment or generalist manipulation policies that transfer across robots and tasks
  • Experience with dexterous multi fingered hands, or with tactile and force torque sensing in closed loop manipulation
  • Experience optimizing and deploying learning based controllers on resource constrained robotic platforms (ONNX Runtime, NVIDIA TensorRT, real time onboard inference)
  • Publications or open-source contributions in manipulation, whole-body control, or robot learning (e.g., CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS)
  • Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 or custom middleware for real-time control
  • Experience debugging sim-to-real issues at scale
Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Restaurant Training Coordinator
description:
Restaurant Training Coordinator

MooCoo Group | Metro Atlanta, GA
Full-Time | Salaried | Multi-Unit Field Position

Turn Your Restaurant Experience Into Developing Others

Are you the person everyone turns to when a new employee needs to be trained? Do you love hospitality, know what great service looks like, and enjoy helping people become more confident and successful at what they do?


MooCoo Group is looking for an experienced Hospitality Training Coordinator to support our growing family of restaurant concepts throughout Metro Atlanta. This is not a traditional restaurant management position, and it is not a floating Manager or shift-coverage role. Instead, you'll spend your time where your experience can make the biggest impact: inside our restaurants, developing Trainers, supporting new hires, reinforcing standards, identifying training gaps, and helping our teams consistently execute the training programs we have built.


If you are an experienced hospitality professional who loves training, coaching, teaching, and developing people, this may be the next step you've been looking for.


What You'll Do

As our Hospitality Training Coordinator, you'll partner with our VP of People & Culture and VP of Operations, while working directly with Store Managers, Trainers, and restaurant teams across multiple concepts.


You'll be our boots-on-the-ground training resource, helping ensure that what we teach on paper translates into what happens every day in our restaurants.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Visit restaurant locations throughout Metro Atlanta to observe and support training.
  • Work alongside Store Managers and designated Trainers to ensure company training programs are being followed consistently.
  • Coach and develop Trainers on how to effectively teach, communicate, demonstrate, and engage new employees.
  • Observe new-hire training and provide hands-on support when needed.
  • Help Trainers turn our training guides into an engaging, hospitality-focused experience rather than simply checking boxes.
  • Verify required training, quizzes, certifications, mock service, and documentation are being completed.
  • Conduct training and service observations to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Assist with individual, departmental, or restaurant-wide retraining.
  • Reinforce FOH and BOH standards, service expectations, menu knowledge, systems and company procedures.
  • Help prepare teams for menu changes, operational rollouts, and new initiatives.
  • Support training for new restaurant openings.
  • Help identify and develop future Trainers.
  • Communicate training observations, successes, and opportunities to Store Managers and company leadership.
  • Help maintain consistency while recognizing that each of our restaurant concepts has its own identity and style.


You'll Work With Everyone

  • This position works across multiple levels of our organization.
  • You'll partner with the VP of People & Culture and the VP of Operations to understand training priorities and expectations.
  • You'll work directly with Store Managers to identify training needs and support their teams.
  • You'll spend significant time with our designated Trainers, coaching them to become stronger teachers and leaders.
  • And you'll work hands-on with our restaurant employees, helping them build the knowledge, confidence, and hospitality skills they need to succeed.
  • Your role isn't to replace any of these people.
  • Your role is to help make all of them stronger.

Who We're Looking For

Restaurant experience matters for this position.

We're looking for someone who understands that great hospitality cannot be taught entirely from a manual.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Several years of full-service restaurant or hospitality experience.
  • Restaurant management, training, or leadership experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of FOH restaurant operations.
  • BOH operational knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience training and onboarding restaurant employees.
  • The confidence to coach employees, trainers, and Managers professionally.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organization and follow-through.
  • The ability to give constructive feedback while maintaining positive working relationships.
  • The ability to recognize when someone needs additional coaching and adjust their training approach.
  • Comfort working independently in multiple restaurant environments.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation.
  • A genuine passion for hospitality and developing people.

Experience with restaurant technology and training platforms is also helpful. Our restaurants utilize systems including Toast, 7shifts, Paylocity, and TipHaus.


Schedule & Travel

This is a field-based Metro Atlanta position, not a traditional Monday–Friday office job. Our restaurants are located throughout Cobb, Fulton, DeKalb, and Gwinnett counties, and regular travel between locations is required. The position will generally work a five-day schedule with two days off each week.


Because you need to see training and hospitality when they're actually happening, your schedule will include a combination of:

  • Daytime administrative and planning time
  • Restaurant training shifts
  • Lunch and dinner observations, including weekends
  • New restaurant opening schedules when applicable

We will work to geographically coordinate restaurant visits whenever possible to reduce unnecessary travel throughout Metro Atlanta.


Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $52,000–$58,000 annually, based on restaurant leadership, training, and multi-unit experience.

As a full-time salaried member of the MooCoo Group team, benefits include:

  • Paid vacation
  • Employee dining/food discounts
  • Benefits available to eligible full-time employees

This position offers the opportunity to move beyond traditional restaurant management while remaining actively involved in hospitality, team development, and restaurant operations across multiple concepts.


Why Join MooCoo Group?

This position offers something different for an experienced restaurant professional. You can stay connected to the energy and people of the restaurant business without spending every week running shifts, writing schedules, or constantly filling staffing holes. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple restaurant concepts, develop people at every level, and have a direct impact on how our teams grow.


We're building training programs designed to create stronger employees, stronger Trainers, and stronger restaurant teams — and we need someone who enjoys being in the restaurants making sure those programs come to life.


If your favorite part of restaurant leadership has always been watching someone you've trained finally "get it," we want to talk to you. Apply today to learn more about becoming MooCoo Group's Hospitality Training Coordinator.

title: Senior Piping Engineer
description:
Title:

Senior Piping Engineer

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals. KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

Job Title: Senior Piping Engineer – Offshore FEED Project

KBR is growing its Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team for an exciting, high‑profile offshore development in Abu Dhabi. The ADNOC PMC project role would be based in Abu Dhabi.

Job Purpose

The Senior Piping Engineer is responsible for executing and coordinating piping engineering and design activities for ADNOC Offshore FEED projects. The role involves the development of piping layouts, material specifications, technical studies, and engineering deliverables for offshore oil and gas facilities while ensuring compliance with ADNOC Offshore standards, project specifications, international codes, and HSE requirements.

The successful candidate will support the design and optimization of offshore process facilities, ensuring safe, reliable, maintainable, and cost-effective piping systems throughout the FEED phase.

Key Responsibilities

Piping Engineering & Design

  • Perform piping engineering activities for offshore FEED projects.
  • Develop and review:
    • Piping Design Basis
    • Piping Material Specifications (PMS)
    • Pipe Class Specifications
    • Line Designation Tables
    • Piping General Arrangement (GA) Drawings
    • Plot Plans and Equipment Layouts
    • Piping Layout Drawings
    • Material Requisitions
    • Valve Specifications
    • Material Take-Offs (MTO)
    • Line Lists
  • Ensure compliance with ADNOC standards and project specifications.
  • Support development of safe, operable, and maintainable piping layouts.

FEED Engineering Deliverables

  • Prepare and review FEED deliverables related to piping design.
  • Assist in the development of:
    • Piping Philosophies
    • Design Criteria
    • Layout Studies
    • Tie-In Packages
    • Constructability Reviews
    • Engineering Reports
  • Ensure engineering deliverables are completed within project schedules and quality requirements.
  • Support scope definition and cost estimation activities.

Piping Layout & Routing

  • Develop piping layouts considering:
    • Offshore space constraints
    • Equipment accessibility
    • Maintenance requirements
    • Safety and escape routes
    • Modularization requirements
    • Weight optimization
  • Participate in 3D model reviews and layout optimization workshops.
  • Coordinate piping routing with process, structural, mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.

Piping Materials Engineering

  • Review and apply material selection requirements for:
    • Carbon Steel
    • Low-Temperature Carbon Steel
    • Stainless Steel
    • Duplex & Super Duplex Stainless Steel
    • Nickel Alloys
    • GRE/GRP Systems
  • Ensure material suitability for process conditions, corrosion control, and design life requirements.
  • Support corrosion studies and material selection reviews.

Stress Analysis Coordination

  • Identify stress-critical piping systems.
  • Coordinate with piping stress engineers on:
    • Flexibility Analysis
    • Thermal Expansion Studies
    • Support Design
    • Sustained and Occasional Load Assessments
    • Vibration Assessments
  • Review stress analysis inputs and recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with piping stress and mechanical integrity requirements.

Offshore & Brownfield Projects

  • Support design of piping systems for:
    • Wellhead Platforms
    • Process Platforms
    • Utility Platforms
    • Gas Compression Facilities
    • Water Injection Facilities
    • Produced Water Facilities
    • Central Processing Facilities (CPF)
  • Participate in brownfield modifications and revamp projects.
  • Review tie-in requirements, shutdown studies, and constructability constraints.
  • Support offshore site surveys when required.

Vendor & Package Engineering

  • Review vendor package piping requirements and interfaces.
  • Coordinate with equipment vendors for:
    • Pumps
    • Compressors
    • Pressure Vessels
    • Heat Exchangers
    • Gas Turbines
    • Utility Packages
  • Review vendor drawings, nozzle orientations, and piping interface requirements.
  • Participate in technical bid evaluations and vendor clarification meetings.

Safety & Risk Management

  • Participate in:
    • HAZID Studies
    • HAZOP Reviews
    • Constructability Workshops
    • SIMOPS Reviews
    • Model Reviews
  • Ensure piping arrangements meet process safety and operational requirements.
  • Promote inherently safer design principles.

Multidisciplinary Coordination

  • Coordinate with:
    • Process Engineering
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Structural Engineering
    • Civil Engineering
    • Electrical Engineering
    • Instrumentation & Control Engineering
    • Pipeline Engineering
    • HSE Engineering
  • Interface with ADNOC Offshore, PMC consultants, licensors, EPC contractors, and vendors.
  • Participate in project meetings, model reviews, and technical workshops.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent Engineering discipline.
  • Master's Degree is an added advantage.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 15 years of piping engineering experience in Oil & Gas projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of ADNOC Offshore project experience.
  • Proven experience in FEED and Detailed Engineering phases.
  • Strong experience in:
    • Offshore Oil & Gas Facilities
    • Greenfield Developments
    • Brownfield Modifications
    • Process Plant Piping Systems

Our Clark location is part of our Taste Division, producing flavors and ingredients. Our Clark facility is unique in the sense they have two buildings. The North building has a fruitier smell to it, the teams in that building are producing natural flavorings and essential oils. The South building is the complete opposite, it will have savory and garlic smells because the team is producing seasonings for meat, chicken broth, and beef gravy.

160 Terminal Ave, Clark, NJ

Shift/Working Hours: 2nd Shift – 2pm to 10:30pm

Primary Purpose: To provide administrative, technical, and testing support within a laboratory setting. Support manufacturing activities alongside Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and R&D departments.

Key responsibilities

1. Perform visual, odor, and taste tests to become knowledgeable regarding raw materials and finished products.

2. Prepare materials and products for laboratory sensory evaluation.

3. Learn sensory, physical, chemical, or instrumental evaluation methods.

4. Retrieve standards and generate worksheets.

5. Maintain clean & safe lab equipment and environment.

6. Perform GC, HPLC, wet chemistry, IR, L.A.B colorimeter, SG, RI, OR, Particle size testing, and other instrumentation testing as needed.

7. Submit evaluation results to respective areas involved.

8. Follows all quality, safety, and company protocols & procedures.

9. Provide extensions for inventory products, including finished goods and raw materials.

10. Benchtop compounding with recipe, BOMs, and batch adjustments.

Qualifications and skills

•  Must be able to taste all products with no dietary restrictions.

•  Must be able to be exposed to and smell a variety of flavor and fragrance products, essential oils, and raw materials.

•  Must be able to stand and work at a lab bench for long periods of time.

•  Must be able to operate lab testing equipment and interpret results.

Educational Requirements:

•  Associate degree plus 1 years' experience in a GMP Laboratory environment. Preferred bachelor's degree in food science, chemistry or similar discipline.

Working Environment:

Laboratory environment with some exposure to the production environment.

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description

What is a Salesperson?

Entry level sales position capable of supporting the DIY business and achieve our sales and service objectives. The role has good knowledge of store systems, basic automotive system knowledge and basic part knowledge. The role has the basic ability to source from stores, hubs, pdq, and external suppliers. The role has in-depth knowledge of the store inventory and maintenance processes. Position can be part time or full time. Fleet safety certification preferred.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for inventory processes including truck put away, shoot outs, cycle counts, Back stock, etc.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Store Cleanliness including floors, bathrooms, facing, dusting, parking lot
  • General stocking including truck stocking and back stock
  • Safely deliver parts to customers as needed

Success Factors

  • Basic driving and navigation ability
  • Ability to use delivery board system
  • Friendly communication
  • Ability to locate and stock parts
  • Safety knowledge and skills
  • Operating inventory systems and store equipment
  • Parts and automotive system knowledge skills
  • Operating POS and Parts lookup systems
  • Expert at testing and diagnostic equipment for DIY service

Essential Job Skills Necessary for Success as a Salesperson

  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with customers, peers and management
  • Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, parts catalogs, and procedure manuals
  • Use basic math accurately: add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Ability to work an assortment of days, evenings, and weekends as needed

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Technicians & Service Advisors
location: Illinois - South Cook County - Calumet City & Lansing Area (173)
description:
Job Title: Technicians and Service Advisors

Employment Type: Full-Time / Part-Time (Non-Exempt)

Pay Range: $15.40/hr and up depending on experience


The Opportunity


Whether you are launching your career under the hood or at the front counter, Jiffy Lube is looking for motivated individuals to join our team as either a Technician or a Service Advisor. Our Technicians are essential to delivering fast, high-quality automotive service in a hands-on, team-oriented environment where you’ll learn valuable technical skills to keep vehicles running safely and efficiently. Meanwhile, our Customer Service Advisors serve as the face of the business, acting as the first point of contact to build trust, educate guests on vehicle maintenance, and drive sales. If you enjoy working with your hands, thriving in a high-energy environment, or working directly with people, Jiffy Lube offers a fast-paced workplace that actively invests in your long-term career growth and professional development.


Our service center teams keep people safely on the road — and we’re hiring people who want to build a career doing it. This is a hands-on role where you’ll work in the service bay and with our guests. Some days you’ll spend more time under the hood, some days more time at the counter. Everyone on our team is trained to do both.


No automotive experience required. We provide industry-leading hands-on training, and many of our store managers started in this exact role.


What You’ll Do


• Greet every guest with a friendly, professional approach and create a positive first impression

• Listen to customer concerns and recommend the right maintenance services for their vehicle

• Conduct vehicle inspections and clearly communicate findings to guests and teammates

• Build trust by educating customers on preventative maintenance and what their vehicle actually needs

• Explain services, pricing, and timelines with confidence and transparency

• Perform oil changes, fluid checks, and preventative maintenance services

• Deliver fast, efficient service without cutting corners on quality

• Support teammates across every area of the shop as needed

• Resolve customer concerns quickly and professionally

• Accurately create service orders and process transactions

• Safely guide vehicles into and out of service bays

• Contribute to store sales and service goals

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all company safety procedures and operational standards


What We’re Looking For


• Previous automotive, mechanical, customer service, retail, or sales experience is a plus — but not required

• Willingness to learn and jump into hands-on training

• Strong work ethic and a positive attitude

• Comfortable talking with people and explaining things clearly

• Ability to multitask and stay organized in a fast-paced environment

• Comfortable working on your feet for extended periods

• Team-oriented mindset — we cover for each other

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends as needed


Work Environment & Physical Requirements


• Ability to stand for extended periods of time

• Work in a service shop environment with exposure to noise, fumes, and varying temperatures

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

• Frequent bending, lifting, and working with tools and equipment

• Ability to occasionally drive customer vehicles


Why Join Our Team?


• Competitive weekly pay

• Bonus and incentive opportunities

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid time off starting Day 1

• Employee discounts

• Industry-leading training programs

• Clear career advancement opportunities

• Team-oriented, supportive work environment


Tell us where you see yourself — under the hood, at the counter, or both. We’ll figure out the right fit together.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
