title: Job Title: Senior QA/QC  Engineer – Offshore  Project
description:
Title:

Job Title: Senior QA/QC Engineer – Offshore Project

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

The KBR team of teams delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals. KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.

Job Title: Senior QA/QC Engineer – Offshore Project

KBR is growing its Project Management Consultancy (PMC) team for an exciting, high‑profile offshore development in Abu Dhabi.

Job Purpose

The Senior QA/QC Engineer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and maintaining the Project Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure that engineering, procurement, construction, fabrication, installation, and commissioning activities comply with ADNOC Offshore requirements, project specifications, international standards, and contractual obligations.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management

  • Implement and maintain the Project Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001, ADNOC Offshore specifications, and project requirements.
  • Review and ensure compliance of Project Quality Plans (PQP), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Method Statements, and Quality Procedures.
  • Monitor project activities to ensure conformance with approved quality requirements and applicable industry standards.
  • Support the Project Quality Manager in achieving project quality objectives and key performance indicators.

Inspection & Surveillance

  • Conduct quality surveillance of fabrication, construction, installation, and commissioning activities.
  • Ensure inspection activities are performed in accordance with approved ITPs and project specifications.
  • Coordinate with ADNOC Offshore representatives, third-party inspectors, and subcontractors during inspections and audits.
  • Witness testing and inspection activities including hydrotesting, pressure testing, NDT, welding inspections, coating inspections, and mechanical completion activities.

Welding & NDT Quality Control

  • Review and approve WPS, PQR, and Welder Qualification Records.
  • Monitor welding activities to ensure compliance with ASME, AWS, and project requirements.
  • Verify NDT activities including RT, UT, MT, PT, and visual inspections.
  • Review welding and NDT reports and maintain quality records.

Material Quality Control

  • Verify material receiving inspections and certification compliance.
  • Review Material Test Certificates (MTCs) and traceability documentation.
  • Ensure proper identification, preservation, storage, and handling of materials.
  • Monitor procurement quality requirements and vendor quality performance.

NCR and Corrective Actions

  • Raise, review, and close Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).
  • Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Follow up on implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.
  • Monitor quality trends and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

Audits & Compliance

  • Participate in internal, supplier, subcontractor, and external audits.
  • Support ADNOC Offshore quality audits and surveillance visits.
  • Ensure compliance with ADNOC HSE and quality requirements.
  • Prepare quality performance reports and audit findings.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain project quality records and documentation.
  • Review turnover dossiers, manufacturing record books, and final quality dossiers.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams regarding quality matters.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Lead Auditor certification in ISO 9001 preferred.
  • CSWIP 3.1/3.2, BGAS, NACE, API, or equivalent certifications are advantageous.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 15 years of QA/QC experience in Oil & Gas, EPC, offshore, or petrochemical projects.
  • Minimum 5 years of ADNOC, ADNOC Offshore, Saudi Aramco, QatarEnergy, or major Middle East offshore project experience.
  • Strong experience in offshore platforms, pipelines, topsides, brownfield, and greenfield projects.
  • Experience in fabrication yards, offshore construction, and commissioning activities.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Description

Quantum Sky is searching for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to build and enhance cloud-based and on-premise cybersecurity and compliance applications for highly regulated environments. This is a hands-on development role

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with experience developing applications in FISMA/FedRAMP environments and familiarity with NIST security and compliance frameworks. They are comfortable owning software across the full development lifecycle—from design and development through CI/CD, deployment, and production operations—and can effectively work across software development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance.

This role includes work on data-intensive risk and compliance analytics products: applications that ingest security and inventory data from multiple, heterogeneous, and sometimes inconsistent sources, normalize it into a consistent internal model, and present risk, gap, and prioritization analytics to different classes of users (executive, program-management, and technical).

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack application capabilities with an emphasis on secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and supporting tools.
  • Build new product capabilities and enhance existing functionality across cloud-based/on-premise cybersecurity and compliance applications, including backend services and user-facing application features.
  • Design and implement integrations with cloud services, security technologies, vulnerability management platforms, monitoring solutions, and third-party systems using REST APIs and structured.
  • Develop capabilities that ingest, process, correlate, and present security and compliance information while automating workflows such as security monitoring, vulnerability management, evidence collection, control management, and reporting.
  • Design data models and normalization/correlation logic capable of reconciling overlapping or conflicting records from multiple independent data sources into a single, consistent, and traceable representation, preserving source provenance and confidence.
  • Design and implement configurable scoring, prioritization, or risk-analytics logic as discrete, testable components rather than embedded business rules — supporting features such as gap analysis, trend analysis, and what-if/scenario comparison.
  • Model relationships and dependencies between assets, systems, and organizational entities in a way that supports drill-down analysis and can scale toward graph-based or dependency-graph representations as products mature.
  • Implement role-based access control and role-differentiated views so that different user types (executive, program/system management, technical) see appropriately scoped and appropriately detailed information.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes that support application builds, automated testing, security validation, and reliable deployment across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Build, deploy, and support containerized and cloud-native applications, collaborating with cloud and DevOps engineers to improve application scalability, reliability, observability, security, and performance.
  • Use AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies as part of day-to-day engineering workflows to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, testing, documentation, and code analysis.
  • Apply engineering judgment when working with AI-generated code and recommendations, validating outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, deployment, and production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including architecture and design discussions, code reviews, testing, documentation, release management, deployment, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
  • Apply secure software development and DevSecOps practices throughout the application lifecycle and collaborate with cybersecurity and compliance subject matter experts to translate security and domain requirements into practical software capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Demonstrated professional experience designing, developing, and supporting production software applications.
  • Experience designing, developing, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating applications with external systems and services.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, backend application architecture, and modern front-end web development technologies — including designing schemas for data that is multi-source, or evolving, not just well-specified from the outset.
  • Experience modeling and querying hierarchical or graph-like relationship data.
  • Experience working within a CI/CD and DevOps-based software delivery environment, including automated builds, testing, deployments, version control, and release processes.
  • Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, using technologies to support repeatable and automated deployments. Experience with Docker, containers, or other managed container platforms

title: Field Sales Engineer – Germany
description:
The role, at a glance:
Biamp, a leading manufacturer of professional electronics for use in the installed audio and video communications market, is currently recruiting a new Field Sales Engineer who will work with customers mostly based in Germany. This position is a primary source for pre-sales technical and design support for all Biamp’s products.
The mission of this technical sales position is to assist the channel sales team in achieving the company’s sales targets by educating end users, consultants, AV integrators and distributors on design and performance attributes of Biamp’s products and technology, in a pre-sale capacity. The goal is to ensure the client specifies the right Biamp system for their project and is certain of achieving the performance they expect. The Field Sales Engineer also provides training and coaching to the design and installation teams for the distributor or AV integrator, with the aim of completing projects more effectively and profitably. This position partners closely with Biamp account managers and members of the business development team, as well as with the technical support team, whilst maintaining a close relationship with the customer.

How you'll contibute:

  • The Field Sales Engineer will take a leadership role through the technology evaluation stage of the sales process with major projects and key clients, remaining available to assist during the development of system design.

  • Manage all elements of the technical communication between Biamp and end users, consultants, AV and control integrators and distributors up to the point where the product is ordered. This includes writing (or participating in writing) proposals, drafting design drawings, providing quotations and creating any technical documentation or guidance required during the pre-sale stage.

  • After being introduced into a project by the Sales or Account Manager, a Field Sales Engineer’s responsibility is to develop relationships with decision-makers and technical staff, becoming their technical resource and reference.

  • Provide demonstrations and training of the technological aspects of Biamp’s products and solutions in the field to system integrators, consultants, end-users and distributors on all aspects of Biamp’s equipment, its functions and its uses.

  • Drive the sales process through all phases requiring technical or design decisions. Fully explain to clients how a Biamp solution solves their issues. Help increase Biamp market share by providing world-class technical expertise on every project.

  • Participate in regional trade shows as necessary, meeting customers at the booth and delivering equipment demos or providing technical expertise.

  • Maintain an ethos of constant self-improvement on sales techniques and technical skills.

  • Work in conjunction with Biamp sales managers as the key technical advisor and product advocate.

  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

  • This position will be located in Germany or a neighboring country.

You'll also support with:

  • Maintaining and upgrading the experience center in our facility.

  • Providing input and guidance for the creation of operations manuals for new products.

  • Creating and proofreading content for Biamp’s online knowledgebase.

  • Reporting client feedback on technical matters to Biamp leadership. Identifying and reporting any areas that could be improved for increased customer satisfaction.

  • Other duties as assigned by your supervisor.

A successful candidate should have:

  • Comprehensive general technical audio, video and control knowledge.

  • Experience with programming and installing AV and control systems.

  • AV networking design experience with CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, ENS, CompTIA or other relevant IT industry qualifications is a big plus.

  • Good computer literacy skills, including working knowledge of the MS Office suite, Visio & CAD programs and EASE Focus / Address.

  • Experience interfacing with distributors, system integrators, consultants, and end-users in the professional audio-visual and control industry.

  • Strong technical presentation skills, and the ability to address a wide range of business and technical people, from company presidents to non-technical staff.

  • Ability to build long-term relationships with customers.

  • Ability to work as part of a team.

  • Experience with international travel.

  • Excellent written and verbal English & Germany skills. The ability to speak and write fluently in another European language (Dutch or French) is a big plus.

  • Relevant degree or professional qualifications are desirable.

The position requires the ability to travel often and at short notice in Germany as
well as occasional trips throughout Europe and Biamp’s headquarters in
Beaverton, Oregon. This position includes the payment of all travel and office
costs, including office equipment. The Field Sales Engineer reports to the Field
Sales Engineering Manager, Europe & Africa.

Work Environment:

  • Work from home with up to 75% of travel.

Who is Biamp?

We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space.

As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences.

About our company:

At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

title: Software Engineer
description:

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture for the platform as we stabilize it and move it to the cloud.

  • Proven AWS solution architecture: EKS, S3, VPC, IAM, networking.

  • Observability architecture: OpenTelemetry pipelines and metrics/traces/logs design (SigNoz, or equivalent such as Grafana/Prometheus/Tempo).
  • Architectural fluency across a Django / React / Go stack.

up to £140,000

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an early-stage AI startup as one of its first engineering hires, taking ownership of a cutting-edge behavioural AI platform that is transforming how companies understand and engage with their customers.

Our client is developing technology that helps their clients better understand not just what customers do, but why they make decisions. You will receive a salary of up to £140,000 depending on experience.

title: Commodities Trader - China
description:
IMC is a global market maker, using advanced technology and sophisticated strategies to trade across major financial markets. With offices in Amsterdam, Chicago, and Sydney, we combine deep market expertise with cutting-edge systems to provide liquidity around the clock.

Our China Commodities desk trades a broad range of products across China's commodity markets, spanning energy, precious metals, and base metals. Combining market expertise, research, and technology, we identify and capture opportunities across one of the world's most significant commodity ecosystems.

As we continue to expand this business, we are looking for an experienced Commodities Trader to develop and execute China-focused trading strategies. Working closely with analysts, quantitative researchers, and technologists, you will help identify opportunities, manage risk, and drive the growth of the desk.

Your Core Responsibilities:

  • Develop, execute, and scale profitable trading strategies across Chinese commodities markets (e.g., energy, precious metals, base metals).
  • Trade futures and related derivatives on major Chinese exchanges (SHFE, DCE, ZCE, INE, GFEX) and relevant offshore venues.
  • Integrate fundamental research, macroeconomic analysis, and geopolitical developments into trading decisions.
  • Partner closely with the Commodities Analyst team to incorporate insights on supply/demand dynamics, inventory trends, shipping flows, regulatory developments, and government policy into actionable strategies.
  • Identify and position around upcoming market catalysts, volatility events, and structural dislocations.
  • Generate directional and volatility-driven trade ideas based on global and domestic Chinese market intelligence.
  • Work alongside quantitative researchers and technologists to refine execution, enhance data-driven decision-making, and scale systematic components of strategies.
  • Actively manage risk, including exposure to macro events, liquidity shifts, regulatory changes, and cross-border dynamics.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of research frameworks, dashboards, and trading tools in collaboration with the Analyst and technology teams.

Your Skills and Experience:

  • Proven track record trading Chinese and/or global commodities futures and derivatives with consistent risk-adjusted returns.
  • Strong understanding of Chinese commodity markets, macroeconomic drivers, and geopolitical influences.
  • Deep knowledge of Chinese exchange rules, margin frameworks, and regulatory environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate fundamental and macro analysis into clear trading positioning.
  • Experience collaborating with analysts, quantitative researchers, and developers in a data-driven trading environment.
  • Strong risk management discipline and ability to trade around event-driven volatility.
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, Bloomberg, or other analytics platforms is advantageous.
  • Ability to operate decisively in a fast-paced, competitive trading environment.

About Us

IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

title: Seasonal Ambassador - Stoneridge
description:
Position: Seasonal Ambassador

0-39 hours/week

Contract Role

Seasonal Ambassador

Seasonal Ambassadors at Lush are experts in product and brand knowledge, as well as providing exceptional customer consultations and product demonstrations. Seasonal Ambassadors cultivate strong team relationships and contribute to overall shop excellence in both sales and operations. On the shop floor, they consistently surpass daily sales goals while creating a fun and inclusive team environment that keeps customers coming back for more.

We encourage you to put yourself in the customer's shoes and think about what would make their day. Whether it's providing personalized product recommendations or sharing your knowledge and expertise, you have the power to create a unique and memorable experience for every shopper.

For our Seasonal Ambassadors, it's not just about selling soap – it's about making a positive impact on the world, one bar at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales and Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize StoreForce dashboard results and seek feedback to exceed sales goals. Take ownership of your results and actively work to grow your contribution to the store’s overall sales.
  • Customer Experience: Consistently deliver a world-class customer experience to every customer who walks through our doors. Connect with customers and identify their needs by listening attentively and asking open-ended questions. Show off our amazing products by demonstrating their unique benefits and features. Seek opportunities to make customers' day and leave the world Lusher than we found it.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on our brand values including our stance on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging. Expertly articulate these values in the shop and through community engagement by hosting store parties and other initiatives that help bring in more traffic. Spread the word about what makes Lush unique, and inspire others to join us in making a positive impact on the world!
  • Product Passion: Continually expand your product knowledge with ongoing learning and diving deep into all things Lush. Stay up-to-date on our products, ingredients, and unique benefits to confidently and consistently make informed product recommendations for every customer's needs.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Utilize Lush resources to develop effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve your performance, support the growth of your team, and increase sales. Take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge, and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members’ perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Time and Attendance: Be punctual, reliable, and present at work. Actively participate in teamwork, prioritize your wellbeing by taking breaks when necessary, and keep up-to-date with company news and updates.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales to improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Ensure you are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing situations and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address issues that arise in day-to-day operations
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French, or other languages

title: Applied Scientist II, Search Ranking, Search Ranking
description:
The Amazon Search team creates customer-focused search solutions and technologies. Whenever a customer visits an Amazon site worldwide and types in a query or browses through product categories, Amazon Product Search services go to work. We design, develop, and deploy high-performance distributed search systems that rank a catalog of billions of products for hundreds of millions of shoppers.

The Search Relevance team owns the ranking models that decide the order of results on every Amazon search page. In this role, you will design and post-train deep ranking models, including LLM-based rankers and multi-tower deep learning models, that jointly optimize purchase, relevance, and personalization. You will invent modeling and training techniques that push the Pareto frontier across multiple objectives, and take your work end to end from novel research prototype through offline evaluation to production online experimentation.

Personalization is a first-class objective on this team. You will build models that reason over each customer's history, durable preferences, and query intent to decide which results best fit that specific customer, rather than optimizing a single population-level ranking.

We treat search as an active research frontier and invest heavily in staying at the leading edge of ML. Beyond today's ranking stack, our current explorations include LLM agents that reason and plan across multi-step workflows, tool-augmented foundation models, and new paradigms that combine retrieval, reasoning, and personalization. You will help chart where search goes next, and see your ideas ship to real customers within weeks, not quarters.

You will work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial team while leveraging the resources of Amazon.com, one of the world's leading technology companies. Please visit https://www.amazon.science for more information.

Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art ranking models that decide how results are ordered on Amazon search, spanning LLM-based rankers and multi-tower deep learning architectures that jointly model engagement, relevance, and personalization.
- Post-train LLMs and ranking models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (e.g. GRPO, DPO, RLHF), knowledge distillation, and listwise ranking losses (e.g. LambdaLoss, ListNet, ListMLE).
- Compose multiple objectives (engagement, relevance, personalization) into a single ranking through principled multi-objective optimization at inference.
- Design large-scale label pipelines, including LLM-as-teacher supervision, that turn customer signals and expert judgment into training and reward signals.
- Optimize inference for production ranking models through quantization, quantization-aware training, teacher-student distillation, and serving-stack tuning.
- Evaluate proposed solutions through offline benchmarks and online A/B tests, and drive the analysis that decides whether a change ships.
- Publish and present your work at internal and external scientific venues in ML, NLP, and IR.

Planning and facilitating daily, weekly, and monthly events to encourage socialization, relaxation, and recreation.

Implementing activities that accommodate those with special needs.

Handling logistics to make the event possible, such as making phone calls, advertising, managing inventory and budgets, training and motivating volunteers or employees, and coordinating transportation.

Observing participants at events gauge their enjoyment and obtain their feedback to improve events.

Keeping records regarding event planning resources, participant interest, and other notable information, such as injuries or behavioral incidents.

Reporting medical concerns or observations.

Ensuring that events are well-provisioned, the event staff is trained and prepared, and that the event takes place on time and within budget.

Providing participants with instructions for the event.

Adhering to and enforcing all safety procedures.

High school diploma and certain certifications may be required.

More education or experience with nursing, recreational activities, event planning, or related may be preferred.

Job training and first-aid and CPR training may be necessary.

Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

Physical fitness, ability to walk, dance, stand, lift, or meet other physical demands.

Adaptability and strong organization and time management skills.

Excellent resource management, computer, record keeping, interpersonal, decision making, and verbal and written communication skills.

Patience and compassion when dealing with others, especially those who are sick, injured, elderly, or from different backgrounds.

Flexibility to work when needed, especially evenings, weekends, or early mornings.

Willingness to adhere to and enforce all safety policies and procedures.

Physical Requirements: Push, pull, move, and/or lift a minimum of fifty (50) pounds to a minimum height of three (3) feet and be able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of fifty (50) feet. (Not a complete list)

description:
Job Title: Technicians and Service Advisors

Employment Type: Full-Time / Part-Time (Non-Exempt)

Pay Range: Starting at $14/hr


The Opportunity


Whether you are launching your career under the hood or at the front counter, Jiffy Lube is looking for motivated individuals to join our team as either a Technician or a Service Advisor. Our Technicians are essential to delivering fast, high-quality automotive service in a hands-on, team-oriented environment where you’ll learn valuable technical skills to keep vehicles running safely and efficiently. Meanwhile, our Customer Service Advisors serve as the face of the business, acting as the first point of contact to build trust, educate guests on vehicle maintenance, and drive sales. If you enjoy working with your hands, thriving in a high-energy environment, or working directly with people, Jiffy Lube offers a fast-paced workplace that actively invests in your long-term career growth and professional development.


Our service center teams keep people safely on the road — and we’re hiring people who want to build a career doing it. This is a hands-on role where you’ll work in the service bay and with our guests. Some days you’ll spend more time under the hood, some days more time at the counter. Everyone on our team is trained to do both.


No automotive experience required. We provide industry-leading hands-on training, and many of our store managers started in this exact role.


What You’ll Do


• Greet every guest with a friendly, professional approach and create a positive first impression

• Listen to customer concerns and recommend the right maintenance services for their vehicle

• Conduct vehicle inspections and clearly communicate findings to guests and teammates

• Build trust by educating customers on preventative maintenance and what their vehicle actually needs

• Explain services, pricing, and timelines with confidence and transparency

• Perform oil changes, fluid checks, and preventative maintenance services

• Deliver fast, efficient service without cutting corners on quality

• Support teammates across every area of the shop as needed

• Resolve customer concerns quickly and professionally

• Accurately create service orders and process transactions

• Safely guide vehicles into and out of service bays

• Contribute to store sales and service goals

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

• Follow all company safety procedures and operational standards


What We’re Looking For


• Previous automotive, mechanical, customer service, retail, or sales experience is a plus — but not required

• Willingness to learn and jump into hands-on training

• Strong work ethic and a positive attitude

• Comfortable talking with people and explaining things clearly

• Ability to multitask and stay organized in a fast-paced environment

• Comfortable working on your feet for extended periods

• Team-oriented mindset — we cover for each other

• Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends as needed


Work Environment & Physical Requirements


• Ability to stand for extended periods of time

• Work in a service shop environment with exposure to noise, fumes, and varying temperatures

• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

• Frequent bending, lifting, and working with tools and equipment

• Ability to occasionally drive customer vehicles


Why Join Our Team?


• Competitive weekly pay

• Bonus and incentive opportunities

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid time off starting Day 1

• Employee discounts

• Industry-leading training programs

• Clear career advancement opportunities

• Team-oriented, supportive work environment


Tell us where you see yourself — under the hood, at the counter, or both. We’ll figure out the right fit together.

title: Director of Development, Walter Scott Jr. College of Engineering
description:
Position Summary


The Director of Development’s primary responsibility is to identify, cultivate, and solicit donors capable of making $50,000+ gifts in support of the Walter Scott Jr. College of Engineering (WSJCOE). The Director of Development (DOD) will manage a portfolio of individual and institutional major gift prospects, presenting comprehensive proposals including current, planned or blended gifts that match the fundraising priorities of the College. This may include soliciting gifts to establish endowed scholarships, fellowships and professorships, departmental programs and centers, research projects, capital priorities, and naming opportunities for related buildings and research centers. The DOD will work in a dynamic team environment, and work in collaboration with central development and cross-college partners to ensure we maximize and celebrate the philanthropic support of our donors.


Position Information

  • Position Title: Director of Development, Walter Scott Jr. College of Engineering
  • Organization Name: Colorado State University Foundation
  • Reports To: Executive Director of Development, Walter Scott Jr. College of Engineering
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • FLSA Status: Exempt
  • Location: Fort Collins, Colorado
  • Salary Range: $95,000 - $120,000 annually
  • Priority Considerations date: 9/27/26


Organizational Overview

Located in the beautiful town of Fort Collins, Colorado State University is a premier land-grant university with world-class programs in education, outreach, and research. CSU has a student body of over 34,000 students, 7,400 employees, 258,000 living alumni, and annual research expenditures exceeding $498 million.


One of eight academic colleges at CSU, the Walter Scott, Jr. College of Engineering houses six academic departments and schools, along with NOAA Cooperative Institute for Research in the Atmosphere (CIRA). The College enrolls approximately 4,000 students and conducts more than $100 million in research annually. Our graduates are employed by, or are leading, national engineering and technology companies across the US and around the world. Researchers in the College have made important contributions to global challenges in energy, health, water, climate, infrastructure and advanced technology.


The Colorado State University Foundation is in the midst of exciting growth as the University Advancement division of CSU transitions to the Foundation. This merger will allow us to more effectively serve our donors, alumni, and stakeholders with a unified structure, strengthen accountability, and build the capacity to scale our fundraising enterprise. With one of the leading development teams in the country, we most recently achieved our highest fundraising year to date in 2025.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies, cultivates, and solicits prospective major gifts of $50,000 and above.
  • Successfully manages complex priorities through careful planning and strategic execution to achieve specific performance metrics.
  • Writes, prepares, and presents persuasive proposals that match the donor’s interests with the College’s fundraising mission and goals.
  • Applies best practices to steward and retain current donors while continually developing a pipeline of new major gift prospects.
  • Makes independent decisions that impact the overall success of the unit’s goals and metrics by raising the productivity of staff and utilizing resources at the highest levels.
  • Recommendations to the Executive Director whether to implement a new plan of action for a specific development activity or to discontinue an existing one.
  • Serves as a key member of the development team by influencing and driving strategy, relationships, and best practices to accomplish goals.
  • Engages with alumni, donors, parents and students, working effectively with cross-campus colleagues to achieve short and long-term fundraising goals.
  • Collaborates with faculty and the dean to enhance programs that will benefit students and faculty.
  • Maintains a high degree of confidentiality and adheres to the industry policies and procedures for accepting, recording, and acknowledging gifts.

title: Junior SOC Analyst Internship
description:
This is a remote position.

The Junior Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst Internship Program at EncryptEdge Labs is designed to provide aspiring SOC analysts with hands-on experience in monitoring and defending against cyber threats. Throughout the eight-week program, interns will engage in practical tasks that cover everything from threat landscape understanding, data collection and analysis, incident response, to vulnerability management and compliance.

Participants will gain exposure to SOC tools, log analysis using the ELK stack, security monitoring with Wazuh, and will develop skills in advanced incident handling and forensic analysis. The program culminates in a capstone project and final presentation that will demonstrate the intern's proficiency in SOC operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Learn and implement SOC techniques, including log management, security monitoring, and incident response.
  • Conduct in-depth data collection, traffic analysis, and log file analysis using tools like ELK and Wazuh.
  • Engage in threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and compliance reporting.
  • Participate in advanced incident handling, forensic analysis, and SOC efficiency improvement.
  • Complete a capstone project and present findings at the end of the internship.

Requirements

Core Attributes:
  • Passion for cybersecurity, with a focus on security operations and threat monitoring.
  • Consistency in meeting deadlines and completing tasks with attention to detail.
  • Strong documentation skills to present findings in a clear, concise, and professional manner.
  • Effective communication skills for working collaboratively with mentors and peers.

Educational Background:
  • A degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

Foundational Knowledge:
  • Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, firewall basics) and operating systems (Windows/Linux).
  • Familiarity with SOC workflows, log analysis, and key cybersecurity concepts is a plus.

Certifications (Preferred):
  • Splunk Fundamentals 1
  • TryHackMe SOC Level 1 Path
  • AlienVault OSSIM Training

Key Skillset:
  • Understanding of log analysis, including recognizing and interpreting security events.
  • Familiarity with alert triaging and prioritization in incident response.
  • Knowledge of common cyber threat vectors (e.g., phishing, malware, ransomware).

Tool Proficiency:
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as:
    • Splunk, Graylog, or QRadar.
  • Familiarity with endpoint monitoring tools like OSSEC and Wazuh.
  • Exposure to threat intelligence platforms (e.g., Recorded Future, AlienVault OTX).

Logistical Requirements:
  • Access to a computer and a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to set up and maintain a secure work environment (guidance will be provided).

Preferred Experience:
  • Completed courses or projects in SOC-related fields or security operations.
  • Participation in security challenges or labs focusing on threat detection and incident response.

Benefits

  • Hands-on Experience: Gain practical knowledge and skills in SOC operations, including threat monitoring, incident response, and log analysis using industry-standard tools.
  • Professional Development: Receive guidance on career development and opportunities to build a portfolio through real-world challenges and presentations.
  • Global Exposure: Participate in a global internship program, connecting with cybersecurity professionals from worldwide.
  • Certificate of Completion: Earn a certificate of completion at the end of the internship, demonstrating your proficiency in SOC analysis.
  • Letter of Experience: Interns who successfully complete the program will also receive a letter of experience, outlining the skills and competencies developed during the internship.
  • Letter of Recommendation: Outstanding interns will receive personalized letters of recommendation from EncryptEdge Labs.
  • Remote Learning: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote internship that allows you to work from anywhere.
  • Mentorship: Access support from experienced mentors and cybersecurity experts throughout the internship.
  • Job Opportunities: Top-performing interns may be recommended for job placements through our network of partners and clients, helping you advance your career in SOC analysis.

description:

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

This role is also responsible for the scheduling and payroll management, as well as assignment of responsibilities and overall staff supervision of the porter team. The Porter Supervisor supports the mission by coordinating the logistics of the perishable and non-perishable resources utilized by our Culinary and Food & Beverage team. Additionally, they perform all of the heavy lifting for event setup, product, and equipment transport, to support with the necessary day to day operations.

  • Receive and inspect deliveries from vendors daily
  • Set and enforce standards for ordering and receiving operations
  • Maintain accurate inventory records for all departmental areas
  • Create awareness among kitchen teams regarding inaccuracies in product deliveries
  • Collaborate with the culinary team to ensure optimal product and vendor selection
  • Monitor and track departmental spending by vendor
  • Reconcile invoices and submit purchase orders for food and equipment vendors
  • Fulfill interdepartmental requests through the internal request system

  • Maintain cleanliness of operational areas and report maintenance issues for repair
  • Manage dishwashers to support kitchen operations and maintain cleanliness of the kitchen and surrounding areas
  • Manage staff scheduling, payroll, and attendance for the team
  • Conduct annual staff performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching and development
  • Ensure all staff training and credentials remain up to date
  • Supervise deliveries of water, ice, and backstock supplies across campus
  • Support internal delivery of supplies for daily operations and events
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment for the team
  • Monitor equipment and asset management, including preventative maintenance
  • Support daily services and perform other tasks as directed by management

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate
  • 2+ years of inventory experience
  • 2+ years of restaurant or retail food service experience
  • 1+ years of leadership experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Customer service and or guest interaction experience

  • Experience with inventory management software
  • Strong writing and verbal communication skills
  • Detail oriented and organized

  • Must be willing to relocate to Bastrop, TX and travel to other sites as needed
  • Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed

The Lead Instrumentation & Control Engineer is responsible for leading and managing all Instrumentation, Control, Safety Systems, and Automation engineering activities for ADNOC Offshore projects during FEED, Detailed Engineering, EPC, commissioning, and start-up phases. The role ensures technical excellence, compliance with ADNOC standards, project schedules, safety requirements, and successful delivery of offshore brownfield and greenfield projects.

title: Part-Time Contract Senior Permit Expediter
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Location: New York,New York,United States

Senior Permit Expediter – Contract / Part-Time

  • Location: New York City
  • Employment Type: Contract / Part-Time
  • Company: Metacomet Construction LLC
  • Pay: $60 - $70/hour

Position Overview

Metacomet Construction is seeking an experienced Senior Permit Expediter to support our construction and renovation projects throughout New York City on a flexible, part-time/contract basis.

This role is intended for an experienced NYC permitting professional who can independently manage the permitting process from pre-filing review through permit issuance and project closeout. The ideal candidate has strong working knowledge of NYC Department of Buildings procedures, DOB NOW, BIS, applicable agency requirements, and the practical realities of moving filings through the approval process.

This is not an entry-level expediting position. We are looking for someone who can review a project, identify potential permitting issues early, develop a filing strategy, coordinate with architects/engineers and project managers, and proactively drive approvals.

Responsibilities

  • Manage DOB filings and permitting for renovation, alteration, and construction projects throughout NYC.
  • Review drawings and project scopes prior to filing to identify potential permitting, zoning, code, or documentation issues.
  • Advise project teams on appropriate filing strategies, permit sequencing, required applications, and agency approvals.
  • Prepare, submit, track, and coordinate applications through DOB NOW and BIS, as applicable.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, special inspectors, contractors, and ownership teams to obtain required documentation and resolve filing issues.
  • Monitor plan examinations, objections, audits, and agency comments and proactively coordinate responses.
  • Attend or coordinate DOB appointments and meetings when necessary to resolve outstanding issues.
  • Manage permit issuance, renewals, amendments, superseding applications, and related filings.
  • Assist with electrical, plumbing, mechanical, fire protection, and other trade-related permitting coordination.
  • Coordinate with other NYC agencies when required, including FDNY, DOT, DEP, LPC, and others depending on project scope.
  • Research existing building records, open applications, permits, violations, certificates of occupancy, and related property documentation.
  • Identify permitting risks that could impact construction schedules and communicate them clearly to the project team.
  • Maintain accurate permit logs and provide concise status updates, including outstanding items, responsible parties, and required next steps.
  • Support project closeout, including sign-offs, letters of completion, certificates of occupancy, and resolution of open applications where applicable.
  • Develop strong working relationships with Metacomet's project management team and become a trusted resource for NYC permitting and filing questions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of NYC permit expediting / filing experience, preferably with significant responsibility for independently managing projects.
  • Strong working knowledge of NYC DOB, DOB NOW, BIS, and NYC permitting procedures.
  • Experience with interior renovations, multifamily residential buildings, commercial spaces, and building alteration projects strongly preferred.
  • Ability to read and understand architectural and engineering drawings.
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between construction scope, filing requirements, permits, inspections, and project closeout.
  • Experience identifying potential filing and permitting issues before they become schedule problems.
  • Established familiarity with NYC DOB borough offices, plan examination procedures, and agency workflows.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple active projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with project managers, architects, engineers, contractors, and agency personnel.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision and take ownership of permitting assignments from start to finish.

Schedule & Structure

  • This is a contract / part-time position with a flexible schedule. The anticipated workload will vary based on active project volume.
  • The role will primarily involve remote coordination and filing work, with availability for in-person agency visits, project meetings, or site visits within New York City when necessary.
  • We are open to structuring the engagement based on the right candidate's availability, including a recurring weekly commitment or project-based arrangement.

What We're Looking For

  • More than anything, we are looking for someone who understands how NYC permitting actually works in practice.
  • The right person should be able to look at a project and tell our team what needs to be filed, what could create problems, what information is missing, and the most efficient path to getting the project permitted. We value responsiveness, practical problem-solving, and proactive communication over simply processing paperwork.

Join M&S as a Customer Assistant in our Food section, where you'll be at the frontline of the UK’s fastest -rowing retailer. We’re not just looking for someone to fill shelves – we need down-to-earth colleagues who thrive under pressure, deliver five-star service at pace, and embrace the transformation we're driving.

We're seeking passionate individuals who not only take pride in their knowledge of M&S Food products but are also ready to roll their sleeves up and go again, day in and day out, meeting strong customer demand head-on.

You'll be a resilient and committed brand ambassador who’s ready to raise the bar by confidently recommending and selling our newest food products to our customers. Through remarkable service you'll make sure our customers feel truly valued every time they shop with us.

· Being digitally confident is essential. You'll utilise our digital tools, such as the Sparks App and our in-store devices, to enhance the customer experience and ensure they get the products they want when they need them.

· Being a team player is crucial. You’ll contribute to a positive, high-energy environment, where everyone works hard and supports each other in delivering a seamless customer experience.

· Flexibility is also vital. You should be poised to work across various areas of the store, adapting to the changing demands of the retail environment. No two shifts will look the same – and you’ll embrace the challenge.

This is a frontline role, not for the faint-hearted. But for those who are ready to roll up their sleeves, there’s huge opportunity. Are you ready for it? Take Your Marks and apply today.

title: License Owner / Operator, Santiago
location: Santiago de Compostela, Municipality of Santiago de Compostela, Spain
description:
Build the Future of Football in Santiago

What if your passion for football could become something you lead, grow, and make your own?

Stranger Soccer is expanding into new cities around the world and is looking for a License Owner / Operator to bring the Stranger Soccer experience to Santiago.

This isn't a traditional management position. It's an opportunity to build, own, and grow a local football operation while becoming part of an established international brand. We're looking for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about football and driven to create a meaningful impact in their local community.

Imagine Being the Person Who...

  • Brings football players together through a seamless mobile platform
  • Builds a vibrant football community in Santiago
  • Creates memorable playing experiences week after week
  • Leads a growing local operation backed by proven technology and global expertise

What You'll Do

As the License Owner / Operator, you'll oversee every aspect of Stranger Soccer, including:

  • Growing the local player community
  • Securing football venues and partnerships
  • Recruiting and managing Official Hosts
  • Leading marketing and community-building initiatives
  • Delivering consistently outstanding game experiences

You'll have the independence to grow your local operation while receiving ongoing support, technology, and operational guidance from our Singapore headquarters.

Why Stranger Soccer?

Stranger Soccer makes playing football as simple as booking a gym session. Through our mobile app, players can discover games, reserve a spot, and simply turn up to play.

Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10+ cities worldwide and has delivered more than 100,000 games. Our proven model is built for growth—and we're ready to bring it to Santiago.

Who We're Looking For

  • A football enthusiast with strong local insight
  • An entrepreneurial self-starter who enjoys taking ownership
  • A leader who can build relationships and grow a local community
  • Someone looking for more than a job—someone who wants to create lasting impact

Ready to Take the Lead?

Visit and explore "Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City" to learn more and express your interest.

Help shape the future of football in Santiago—and build something you'll be proud of.

title: Software Developer | AI-Driven Engineering
description:
Software Developer | AI-Driven Engineering | Cloud-Native Development | Modern Tech Stack

We are looking for passionate Software Developers who are excited to build the next generation of intelligent software. This opportunity is designed for engineers who thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace emerging technologies, and leverage Artificial Intelligence to develop innovative, scalable, and secure solutions.

DevOps & Engineering

  • Git

  • GitHub Actions

  • Jenkins
  • Azure DevOps
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies

  • Generative AI
  • Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • OpenAI APIs
  • Azure OpenAI
  • GitHub Copilot
  • Cursor AI
  • Claude AI

  • AI Agents & Agentic Workflows
  • Prompt Engineering

  • AI-assisted Software Development

Development Practices

  • Microservices Architecture
  • Event-Driven Architecture
  • REST APIs
  • GraphQL
  • Test-Driven Development (TDD)
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • Secure Software Development (DevSecOps)
  • Clean Code & SOLID Principles

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Passion for Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable, and high-performance applications.
  • Curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning mindset.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work in multicultural and distributed engineering teams.

Join a team where innovation, AI, and software engineering excellence come together to shape the future of technology.

Next Step:

Please remember to check your email and complete your One-Way Video Interview. This is the next step in our hiring process and will help us learn more about your technical experience, problem-solving approach, and professional background. We look forward to getting to know you!

Software Developer | Strong Fit Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language:
  • Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Go, Kotlin, or Rust.
  • Hands-on experience with modern frameworks:
  • React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js, .NET, Spring Boot, Node.js, Django, or FastAPI.
  • Cloud platform experience:
  • AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience developing REST APIs and/or Microservices.
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools:
  • Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with AI technologies or AI-assisted development:
  • OpenAI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, or LLMs.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and scalable application design.
  • Resume includes measurable technical achievements and business impact.
  • Professional English communication skills (B2+ preferred).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Strong Fit Indicators (Bonus) ⭐

Candidates stand out if they also have:

  • SaaS or Product Development experience.
  • AI-powered application development.
  • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Active GitHub portfolio or Open Source contributions.
  • Experience in fast-paced startup or technology companies.
  • Passion for continuous learning and emerging technologies.

title: Architecture Discipline Lead, Part-Time
description:
AECOM ’s Great Lakes Buildings + Places team is seeking an experienced and visionary Architecture Team Lead-Part-Time to oversee and guide the Great Lakes architectural team in delivering innovative, high-quality, client-focused design solutions. This role requires a dynamic leader who combines design excellence, technical expertise, and strong project management skills to ensure the successful execution of architectural projects across a variety of market sectors. The Architecture Team Lead will play a critical role in managing multidisciplinary projects, providing technical leadership, mentoring team members, and fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to achieve project excellence. This role is a hybrid position located in Chicago, IL.

AECOM is a globally recognized architecture and engineering design firm whose diverse, creative teams deliver positive impact to millions of people worldwide. We operate collaboratively across business lines and regions, trusted to deliver some of the most complex projects on the planet. Our Client Promise - excellence, innovation, measurable value - reflects our dedication to understanding needs, exceeding expectations, and achieving shared goals, grounded in integrity, collaboration, and innovation.

About the Great Lakes Buildings + Places Team

With offices in Chicago, Indianapolis, Detroit, Grand Rapids, and Minneapolis, the Great Lakes practice is one of the fastest growing and highest-performing B+P practices in AECOM’ s West Region. We offer a full suite of services: architecture, interiors, building systems and structural engineering, urbanism and planning (including landscape), workplace transformation, advisory services, technology solutions, and digital delivery - and serve as a Center of Excellence for many of these disciplines.

We work in a collaborative model across the West Region with other B+P practices, as well as with AECOM’s Transportation, Water, Environment and Advisory business lines to support vertical infrastructure and comprehensive solutions. Our practice supports a diverse portfolio of local, national, and global clients across the private, public, and federal sectors, delivering impactful projects in the Public (Non-Federal), Cultural and Civic, Commercial, Healthcare, Science and Technology, Transit, Aviation, and Federal markets. Most clients are repeat partners, recognizing our service model and outcomes as excellent. Recognized by over 45 design awards in the past five years, we aim to be the design firm of choice for clients and the employer of choice for diverse, best-in-class talent - doing the work that matters.

Recent/ongoing projects include: Corporate Headquarters Interior Fit-Out, Milwaukee County Courthouse; Interior Fit-Outs for National Financial Client; City of Chicago Joint Police and Training Center Emergency Medical Services Addition; Lake County Convention Center.

What You’ll Do

The Architecture Team Lead is a senior leadership role responsible for delivering design excellence, driving project performance, and developing high-performing teams. This role balances hands-on design leadership with people management, client engagement, and business outcomes—supporting practice growth, profitability, and long-term client relationships in alignment with regional and national objectives.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Team & Practice Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects, fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Manage staffing, workloads, and resource allocation to ensure efficient project delivery.
  • Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and support career development.
  • Contribute to practice growth through team development, client engagement, and market presence.

Client & Business Engagement

  • Serve as the primary client contact and trusted advisor.
  • Facilitate effective communication with owners, consultants, contractors, and authorities having jurisdiction.
  • Lead client meetings, design reviews, and progress updates.
  • Participate in business development, proposal preparation, and client engagement activities to support practice growth.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships that drive repeat work and referrals.
  • Strengthen AECOM’s presence in the design community through relationships with clients, consultants, and industry partners.

Project Delivery

  • Lead architecture and engineering projects from proposal award through completion
  • Develop and manage project execution plans, schedules, staffing plans, and budgets
  • Ensure adherence to contract requirements, scope, and fee structure
  • Monitor project performance, proactively addressing risks and challenges to maintain efficiency and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee quality management processes and ensure technical excellence

Financial & Contract Management

  • Manage project financial performance, including:
    • Budget tracking and forecasting
    • Change management and amendments
    • Monthly invoicing and revenue recognition
  • Review and negotiate contracts, scopes of services, and project deliverables
  • Ensure compliance with company financial and risk management policies

Industry Engagement

  • Represent AECOM at industry events, conferences, and exhibitions.
  • Stay current on design trends, innovations, and best practices, sharing insights with teams and clients.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture or related field + 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of education/experience.
  • Professional licensure in field of study.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of experience at a large architectural firm, including 5+ years in project management and leadership.
  • Master’s degree in Architecture or Business.
  • Core & Shell Project management experience.
  • Experience in one or more specialized markets (workplace, justice, federal, transit, aviation, healthcare).
  • Experience with multiple delivery methods: CM/GC, DB, DBROM, PPP, EPC/EPCM
  • Familiarity with risk management, contract negotiations, and dispute resolution.
  • Detail-oriented, thorough, well-organized; excellent time management.
  • Experience supporting proposals, pursuits, and client interviews
  • Proven ability to lead teams and deliver projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong client management skills with a demonstrated ability to grow existing and new client relationships.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Experience contributing to thought leadership through panels, presentations, or publications.
  • Sponsorship is not available now or in the future for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Utrecht | 32 - 40 uur p/w | € 5.000 - € 7.000

Word onderdeel van een community waar developers centraal staan.

Je bent een ervaren Java Developer. Je wilt werken aan uitdagende opdrachten, blijven groeien in je vak en werken bij een werkgever die jou ziet als developer, niet als een nummer.

Bij Codefield sta jij centraal. Samen kiezen we opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw technische ambities, interesses en een gezonde werk-privébalans. Zo combineer je uitdagende projecten bij opdrachtgevers van Codefield met de zekerheid van een vast contract en de betrokkenheid van een hechte developer community.

Dat is waar wij voor staan. Je wordt onderdeel van een community van ruim 25 ervaren developers, waar kennis delen, persoonlijke groei en plezier hand in hand gaan. Tijdens DEV-Days en kennissessies ontwikkel je jezelf technisch én persoonlijk, afgewisseld met teamuitjes, spelavonden, een familiedag en jaarlijkse teamweekenden. Zo bouw je niet alleen aan impactvolle applicaties en software, maar ook aan een team waar je graag onderdeel van bent.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Senior Java Developer werk je aan opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw technische ambities. Samen kijken we naar de techniek, de organisatie, de reisafstand en de manier van werken, zodat jij terechtkomt op een plek waar je energie van krijgt. Daarom werk je in de meeste gevallen hybride en ben je maximaal twee dagen per week op locatie.

Je ontwikkelt moderne Java-applicaties, microservices en RESTful API's met de nieuwste Java-, Spring Boot- en cloudtechnologieën. Je denkt actief mee over architectuur, ontwerpt schaalbare cloud-native oplossingen en schrijft kwalitatieve, onderhoudbare code die klaar is voor productie. Met testautomatisering, code reviews en bewezen engineering best practices draag je bij aan betrouwbare, veilige en goed presterende software die dagelijks door duizenden gebruikers wordt gebruikt.

Naast je opdrachten blijf je jezelf continu ontwikkelen. Je verdiept je in de nieuwste Java-frameworks, AI-tools en cloudontwikkelingen en deelt je kennis binnen de Codefield-community tijdens DEV-Days, kennissessies en andere technische events. Zo blijf je niet alleen vooroplopen in je vak, maar help je ook je collega's verder groeien.

  • Direct een vast contract
  • Sterke pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage van circa 16%
  • Leaseauto (inclusief tankpas voor privégebruik), OV Business Card of reiskostenvergoeding
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8,33% vakantiegeld en de mogelijkheid om 6 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen
  • Betaald sabbaticalprogramma: 2 weken extra verlof na 2 jaar en 1 maand na 5 jaar
  • Volop ruimte en budget voor opleidingen, trainingen en Microsoft-certificeringen
  • €5.000 onboardingbudget voor je laptop, workgear en thuiswerkplek
  • DEV Community Days, wekelijkse borrels, padel, teamactiviteiten en een jaarlijks teamweekend
  • Een modern kantoor in Utrecht met goede koffie, een gameroom (simrig, PS5, pooltafel en dartbord) en volop ruimte om collega's te ontmoeten.

Technologieën waar je mee werkt

Geen opdracht is hetzelfde. Daarom werk je niet altijd met exact dezelfde technologieën. Afhankelijk van de opdrachtgever en het project kom je regelmatig onderstaande technieken tegen. Je hoeft niet overal ervaring mee te hebben, maar je vindt het leuk om jezelf hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

  • CI/CD pipelines, Cloud native development, DevSecOps, Docker, Event-driven architecturen, Git, Kubernetes, Microservices

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een ervaren Java Developer die verder kijkt dan alleen code. Je denkt graag mee over technische keuzes, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van software en krijgt energie van samenwerken met andere developers. Je blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en vindt het leuk om jouw kennis te delen.

Voor deze rol vragen we:

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Java Developer.
  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met Java en Spring Boot.
  • Je voelt je thuis binnen Agile-, Scrum- en DevOps-teams.
  • Je denkt verder dan alleen code en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid.
  • Je vindt het leuk om technische keuzes te maken, kennis te delen en collega's verder te helpen.

Codefield gelooft in een inclusieve werkomgeving en nodigt iedereen uit te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, gender of cultuur.

Our vision

As a leading iron ore producer, Hancock Iron Ore is helping secure the resources, jobs and prosperity that underpin the nation’s future. Guided by our vision to be the best mining company for Australia, we measure success not only by what we produce, but by the difference we make. We value creating opportunities, helping build regional and remote areas, and supporting Australian businesses by unlocking potential wherever it exists. Being 'For Australia' means delivering lasting benefits for today and for generations to come.

About the role:

Hancock Iron Ore is seeking a Senior Analyst – AHS Technology Operations Centre to join our Technology Operations team on a 7/7 days and nights roster based at our Remote Operations Centre (ROC) in West Perth.

Reporting to the Supervisor Technology Operations Centre, you will provide technical expertise for Hancock Iron Ore’s Autonomous Haulage System. This includes providing application support across the offboard environment, including applications, servers and network layers.

As the primary escalation point for autonomous haulage incidents in the Remote Operations Centre, you will work within a 24-hour operational model to proactively monitor service performance and provide real-time technical support to operational personnel. You will lead complex incident investigations and collaborate closely with internal Technology teams and vendors to restore services, strengthen system reliability and maintain high service availability.

Duties:

  • Serve as the key contact for Autonomous Haulage System incidents reported by operational teams or identified through system alerts and monitoring platforms. Assess, triage, troubleshoot and document incidents in ServiceNow, with a focus on safe and effective resolution at first contact
  • Provide advanced operational support and technical investigation across the offboard Autonomous Haulage System environment, including applications, servers, system integrations, interfaces and network connectivity
  • Proactively monitor system dashboards, logs, alerts, infrastructure health indicators and performance data to identify faults, emerging trends and potential service degradation, and determine the appropriate recovery or escalation pathway
  • Coordinate and lead the technical response to Technology Major Incidents, ensuring timely engagement of relevant Technology teams, engineering resources and vendors, while providing clear and consistent updates to operational and Technology stakeholders
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to Technology Operations Centre Analysts, supporting capability development and consistent operational support practices
  • Identify recurring incidents and service improvement opportunities and contribute to the knowledge base by documenting resolutions and developing troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures

Skills and Experience:

description:
Bliv den dygtigste specialist du kan være

Hos savvyrevenue er vi er et elite-team af 12 specialister, der går i dybden. Vi bliver kaldt ind, når det er komplekst.

De specialister, der trives hos os, deler tre ting:

1) Dygtige til det tekniske: Du er stærk i eksekveringen og omsætter idéer til resultater i Google Ads.

2) Passioneret: Du er ikke bare dygtig til det, men du synes det er sjovt at være hands-on i kontiene.

3) Strategisk sparringspartner: Du kobler din tekniske viden med kundens forretning og kan tale om blended ROAS, budgetter og forecasting.

Hverdagen som Senior Specialist i savvy:

Bliv ekspert

Vi har markedets stærkeste frameworks og et struktureret coaching-forløb.

Du behøver ikke vide alt fra dag 1, men du skal have viljen til at ville blive ekspert.

Arbejd med komplekse cases:

Vi tiltrækker kunder, der stiller høje krav.

Det kræver, at du bruger hovedet til at opfinde nye løsninger fremfor at følge en tjekliste.

Scripts, Sheets og AI:

Med AI’s hjælp har vi automatiseret flere kedelige opgaver, og søger specialister, der vil med på den rejse.

Du er eksperten:

Vores kunder har valgt os, fordi de vil arbejde med de bedste.

De forventer modspil og sparring, ikke bare en månedlig rapport.

Din profil

Erfaring: Du har typisk 2-3 års erfaring (min. 1 år, hvis du er hurtig). Du har lært grundprincipperne, og søger et sted, hvor du kan tage dit niveau fra “god” til “ekspert”.

Du søger sparring: Hos os sidder du ikke alene. Vi har en kultur med struktureret feedback og coaching, fordi vi tror på, at selv de bedste kan blive bedre gennem løbende sparring.

Selvkørende men holdspiller: Du behøver ikke en chef til at fortælle dig, hvad du skal lave i dag. Du trives med frihed under ansvar, men vil gerne have nogen at tale med om tingene.

Om savvy som arbejdsplads

Vi er et lille, tæt team, der elsker det vi laver – men vi elsker også at have det sjovt sammen:

Socialt samvær: Vi prioriterer det sociale højt med månedlige middage på gode restauranter, lavpraktiske madaftener og sociale events, som skifter fra måned til måned (escape room, gocarts, cocktail kurser).

Den årlige sommerhustur: Det er her, vi virkelig kommer tæt på hinanden, slapper af og skaber en kultur uden for kontoret. Det er en fast tradition, vi værner meget om.

Plads til det hele: Vi går op i trivsel. Derfor har vi bl.a. en altid fyldt snackbar, lækker frokostordning, fleksible arbejdstider samt en kultur hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

Pension og arbejdsvilkår

Pension & arbejdssted

Vi følger en trappestigemodel, som man starter på efter ét års ansættelse. Op til 6% pension via arbejdsgiverbidrag.

Arbejdssted:

  • Vores nye lokaler på Værnedamsvej i København
  • Hjemmearbejde er fint en gang om ugen, men vi arbejder alle fra kontoret 4/5 dage om ugen.

Investering i udvikling

Deruover investeres der hvert år 12.000 kr. i dig på områder der bidrager til din trivsel, det er bl.a.:

  • Træning: kommunikationstræning, mindfulness, time blocking
  • Kurser: Finder du et kursus du brænder for, så betaler vi
  • Konferencer: Ind og udland med alt betalt

Proces for ansættelse

Send os dit CV og ansøgning via formularen.

2. Indledende samtale med Head of People

Den indledende samtale er med Isabella, vores Head of People.

3. Anden samtale med Andrew og Filip
